ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes exhibit high-intensity white contiguous zones with internal linear black striations. Left lobe: large white blob spanning the distal third with irregular black horizontal streaks. Right lobe: white region at the distal tip with diagonal black marks. Central peduncle and upper lobe regions are dominated by low-intensity black pigmentation with sparse white punctate spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees; notch depth is approximately 8% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; pixel-level peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the inner trailing edges of both lobes approaching the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a moderately convex curve from the distal tips, transitioning to a linear-concave trajectory towards the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Reddish-brown high-contrast pixel cluster at the extreme left fluke tip indicating biological colonization or tissue exposure. Multiple white circular clusters (rosettes) are localized within the central black pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant density of unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks). Primarily oriented vertically on the right lobe's black surface and diagonally across the white pigmentation of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced structural irregularity and color deviation at the left-most distal tip, characterized by a jagged boundary and reddish-brown pixel clusters.
